questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The disabled should not be oppressed.

options.text: Let not the disabled be oppressed.
The disabled have not been oppressed
We should not be oppressing the disabled

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Do not oppress the disabled.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Given sentence **"****The disabled should not be oppressed"** is in **Simple Present Tense **and in **Passive voice**.
 
• The rule for changing a simple Present Indefinite tense form into an Active voice is as follows:
 
 
• ​Interchange the subject with the object and vice-versa. 
 
• While converting the negative sentences with should into an active voice, the subject starts with Do not. 
 
• Convert the verb "Disable" into a past participle or 3rd form of the verb.
 
• "Should not" will change into "Do not."
 
• Structure: **Subject + first form of verb + Object.**
 
 
 
• **Example: ***The car should not be moved.* *(Active Voice)*

 *Do not move the car. (Passive Voice)*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Active voice** is used when the subject of the sentence does the action.
 
• The **P****assive voice** is used when we focus on the object of the sentence.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

I was not hired by her.

options.text: She was not been hired me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'She did not hire me'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Simple Past Tense **and in **Passive voice.**
 
• Rules to change a **Passive **voice to an **Active **voice :
 
• The subject and object are interchanged i.e. the subject become the object and the object becomes the subject.
 
• Passive pronouns (her) change to active pronouns (she).
 
• Active pronouns (I) change to passive pronouns (me).
 
• 'By' is removed.
 
• The structure :
 
 
• **Object + was/were+ not +V3+ by Subject **(Passive voice)
 
• **Subject +did+ not+v1+ object **(Active voice)
 
 
• Example- She was not taken by him. (Passive voice)
 
• He did not take her. (Active voice)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In passive voice, a sentence emphasizes the object performing an action.
 
• In active voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It provides a high-quality learning opportunity, improves student outcomes and skills, and expands educational choice options

B. Therefore, location, time, and quality are no longer considered factors in seeking degree courses or higher education because of online education.

C. Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet.

D. Its potential advantages involve increased educational access.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'CDAB'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence **C **comes first as it gives an introduction and definition regarding the subject matter i.e online education.
 
• Sentence **D** comes second as it carries the definition to the advantages point.
 
• Sentence **A** comes next as it continues the advantages part.
 
• Sentence **B** comes last as it concludes the whole discussion about online education.
 
• Hence, the right order is **CDAB**.
